statement: let L := fun n : ℕ => if n=0 then (0:ℝ) else (-1:ℝ)^n.primeFactorsList.length; let C := fun n : ℕ => (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, L t * L (n-t))/(n:ℝ); ∀ (N p : ℕ), 0 < N → Nat.Prime p → p ∣ N → (∑ t ∈ (Finset.range N).filter (fun t => p ∣ t), L t * L (N-t))/((N/p:ℕ):ℝ)=C (N/p)
